subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) He told her that, if she could bring a handful of mustard seed from a house where nobody had died, her son would be alive again. (b) She requested Buddha to bring her dead son back to life again. (c) Buddha told her that, death is inevitable to everybody and it was not possible to bring back her dead son to life. (d) One day a woman came to Buddha with her dead son. (e) She returned to Buddha with a broken heart and said him everything. (f) The sorrowful mother went from door to door but in every house she faced with sad reply. (g) Buddha could realize the emotion and sorrow of the bereaved mother. (h) In every house she saw that death had shown its cruel face. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d b g a f h e c One day a woman came to Buddha with her dead son. She requested Buddha to bring her dead son back to life again. Buddha could realize the emotion and sorrow of the bereaved mother. He told her that, if she could bring a handful of mustard seed from a house where nobody had died, her son would be alive again. The sorrowful mother went from door to door but in every house she faced with sad reply. In every house she saw that death had shown its cruel face. She returned to Buddha with a broken heart and Laid him everything. Buddha told her that, death is inevitable to everybody and it was not possible to bring back her dead son to life. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 263
